| Symbol | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [`ECNConfig`](/reference/python/configuration/ecn-config/) | Configure one immutable SDK MQTT v5 connection. |
| [`ReconnectPolicy`](/reference/python/configuration/reconnect-policy/) | Configure one bounded exponential reconnect policy with mandatory full jitter. |
| [`ReviewedContainerNetwork`](/reference/python/configuration/reviewed-container-network/) | Record an operator attestation the SDK cannot prove; the SDK enforces that every resolved address is private and revalidated on connect and reconnect. |
| [`load_config`](/reference/python/configuration/load-config/) | Load a named non-secret profile with environment overrides. |
| [`AuthConfig`](/reference/python/configuration/auth-config/) | Authentication configuration discriminated by the literal `kind` field. |
| [`BearerTokenAuth`](/reference/python/configuration/bearer-token-auth/) | Configure MQTT CONNECT authentication with a current bearer token. |
| [`MTLSAuth`](/reference/python/configuration/mtls-auth/) | Configure MQTT authentication with a client certificate and private key. |
| [`NoAuth`](/reference/python/configuration/no-auth/) | Configure no-auth, which is not a standalone unauthenticated mode and is accepted only with an explicit reviewed-container-network attestation and explicit TLS disablement. |
| [`CertificateMaterial`](/reference/python/configuration/certificate-material/) | Provide a certificate from a filesystem path or secret PEM text. |
| [`PrivateKeyMaterial`](/reference/python/configuration/private-key-material/) | Provide a private key from a filesystem path or secret PEM text. |
| [`TLSConfig`](/reference/python/configuration/tls-config/) | Configure TLS transport and optional custom certificate authority material. |
| [`TokenProvider`](/reference/python/configuration/token-provider/) | A cooperative asynchronous callable that supplies the current bearer token. |
| [`CredentialsProvider`](/reference/python/configuration/credentials-provider/) | A cooperative asynchronous callable supplying one username-token pair. |
| [`WireFormat`](/reference/python/configuration/wire-format/) | Select the entity and location payload encoding. |
